# Permissions Google allows in a custom role (customRolesSupportLevel empty = GA/supported),
# restricted to the service prefixes the Terraform modules use.
# Read by TestCustomRolePermissionsAreAllowedByGoogle (deploy/terraform/terraform_test.go),
# which fails when a `permissions = [...]` list in deploy/terraform names a permission not listed here.
# Generated 2026-10-18 with:
#   gcloud iam list-testable-permissions //cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com/projects/<project> --project <project> --format='value(name,customRolesSupportLevel)'
# keeping the rows whose second column is empty and whose name starts with one of the prefixes
#   apikeys artifactregistry batch billing* cloudasset cloudbuild cloudscheduler compute datastore firebase* iam
#   identitytoolkit logging monitoring resourcemanager run secretmanager serviceusage storage
# To refresh: re-run the command, filter the same way, replace the lines below (sorted, one per line),
# and add the prefix of any new service a module uses. A permission at level TESTING or NOT_SUPPORTED
# must stay out: Google refuses it in a custom role or may change it.
